title: Closure review — T4 (retrospective, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Closure review — T4 Kanban coach (retrospective, 2026-11-22)

## Outcome vs acceptance

T4's section 12 gate asks that an injected failure yield exactly one coach card and one remedy; that a repeat signature escalate; that no coach card be opened about a coach card; and that a systemic class open a kata. A first interruption yields the card, triage and remedy (`coach.rs:577`), the repeat escalates (`coach.rs:683`) and the depth cap holds (`coach.rs:745`, `:1343`). The 'exactly one' is not universal: a fourth distinct signature is dropped by the per-card cap (v1-p6-4). The systemic class starts a kata process but not a kata record (v1-p6-2). The level is non_conformant.

## Evidence

- `acceptance/programme/T4.toml` — the project's manifest.
- `crates/actions/tests/coach.rs` — the named gate tests at lines 577, 683, 745, 816, 864, 1131 and 1343.
- `crates/actions/tests/process_catalogue.rs:262`, `crates/actions/tests/registry.rs:665`, `crates/store/tests/s07_seed.rs:18` — the seeded catalogue.
- `migrations/0057_coach.sql` — `coach_interruption` and `coach_remedy`.
- the 2026-11-22 project row in `/tmp/u7-snapshot/data/programme.json` — `closed`, version 10, tranche 4.

## Open items

- `v1-p6-2` (P1) — the systemic path stops at a process-run id; no kata record, instrument, threshold, measurement or adoption gate. Owned by T4.
- `v1-p6-4` (P1) — the per-card cap and the live-run skip drop distinct signatures. Owned by T4.
- `v1-p6-5` (P1) — only failed runs produce interruptions. Owned by T4.
- `v1-p6-6` (P2) — `cards.create` can mint an orphan coach card. Owned by T4.

None is waived.

## Decision

Retain the register's `closed` status on the P0-only product gate. Requested by the programme's service actor `conveyor-e2e` and decided by the distinct approver `conveyor-approver` under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`; the requester is not the approver. The four open items are carried into the next tranche and must be disposed by a dated decision at the programme's viability review if still open.
